status: declaration only: no import or export to these standards is implemented; names are for orientation and future connectors

pinned.osdu: OSDU Data Platform schemas M23 (well-known names)
pinned.evo: not declared: no public, version-pinned schema was verified for this checkpoint

differences: No wellbore identity is carried: the tops are associated explicitly with an exact uploaded well log, never matched by name.
Depth reference is the uploader's statement (same-as-log / other / unknown), not an OSDU VerticalMeasurement record.
Stratigraphic interpretation, age and surface/feature links are not represented.
Only measured depth, inclination, azimuth and an optional provided TVD are kept; no tie-in point, grid convergence, magnetic declination or survey tool.
Calculated positions are offsets relative to the first station (minimum curvature), never absolute coordinates.
Azimuth reference is declared by the uploader or unknown; nothing is corrected between references.

types.osdu: work-product-component--SeismicHorizon / Grid2dRepresentation-like regular lattice (no direct OSDU storage schema declared)
differences: Axis-aligned lattice only (no rotation, single cell size); first row is the northmost as in ESRI ASCII grids.
CRS is an EPSG code or unknown; no transformation is applied; vertical datum and positive direction are declarations.

Differs from ophiolite/scalar-map/1 (native exchange): that profile has no registration, positive-direction or vertical-datum declaration and requires a declared CRS status; E11 does not convert between them.

types.osdu: work-product-component--SeismicHorizon / generic surface (no direct OSDU storage schema declared)
differences: One triangle patch; no split edges, faults or multiple patches.
Coordinates as written; the declared CRS is not transformed.
Attributes are numeric per-vertex values only.

types.osdu: work-product-component--GenericRepresentation / point-set-like (no direct OSDU storage schema declared)
differences: A single patch of points; no property kinds beyond numeric attributes.
Coordinates as written; the declared CRS is not transformed.

types.osdu: work-product-component--GenericRepresentation / point-set-like (no direct OSDU storage schema declared)
types.energistics: RESQML 2.0.1 PointSetRepresentation with continuous, discrete (text) and categorical properties
differences: A single patch of points; text and category attributes are kept as written, with no RESQML property-kind or string-lookup mapping.
Coordinates as written; the decided CRS is not transformed and time is not converted to depth.

types.osdu: work-product-component--FaultInterpretation with polyline geometry (no one-to-one stick set)
types.energistics: RESQML 2.0.1 PolylineSetRepresentation (fault sticks as polylines of a FaultInterpretation)
types.opendtect: FaultStickSet ASCII export (x y z stick-index [node-index])
types.evo: not declared: an Evo line-segment mapping was not verified against a public, version-pinned schema
differences: No fault identity or interpretation is carried; sticks are geometry only.
The node-index column of the OpendTect export is not kept (point order is).
CRS, units and vertical meaning are the uploader's declarations; no transformation is applied.

types.energistics: RESQML 2.0.1 Grid2dRepresentation for the survey geometry; samples stay in the SEG-Y original
types.segy: SEG-Y rev 1 / rev 2.0: formats 1 and 5, big-endian, fixed-length traces, full inline × crossline grid
differences: Only regular full grids are supported; the survey's bin-grid corner points are not derived, first and last CDP coordinates are reported as written.
Every header interpretation is recorded as a decision in the fidelity report; nothing else from the textual header is interpreted.
Slices are the published representation of samples; the full volume is available only as the exact original.

types.energistics: WITSML 2.1 Well / WellLocation (Easting, Northing or Latitude, Longitude with a CRS)
differences: One surface point per file; no location history, survey or wellbore path.
The CRS is the one the file states; nothing is transformed at upload.
Which well it locates is an explicit of-entity association, never inferred from the file.

types.osdu: work-product-component--WellLog with LogCurveFamily Waveform (as the SeismicWellTie example WellLog.Ricker40.json)
types.energistics: not declared: no Energistics object holds a standalone wavelet
differences: Samples, interval, first time and polarity are the file's own statements; the declared kind and frequency are recorded as written, not checked against the samples.
No well or depth reference is carried: a wavelet is not attached to a wellbore.

types.osdu: none: no OSDU kind holds a rock-index grid of P-wave velocity and density on 2D section axes
differences: Rocks carry one P-wave velocity and one density each; property grids are not represented.
No map position or coordinate system: the horizontal axis is distance or trace number.

types.osdu: work-product-component--SeismicTraceData (a 2D line; no SeismicLineGeometry is carried)
differences: No trace headers or map position: the axes are the file's declared vertical and horizontal axes.
A synthetic section names its rock model and wavelet as parents; that lineage is Ophiolite's, not an OSDU relationship.

types.osdu: none: a text format; its normalized profile is ophiolite.wavelet/1
none: a text format; its normalized profile is ophiolite.model-section/1
none: a text format; its normalized profile is ophiolite.seismic-section/1
work-product-component--WellLog 1.5.0 (LogCurveMainFamily TimeDepth; curves CheckshotOneWayTime or CheckshotTwoWayTime against depth; SeismicReferenceElevation)
types.energistics: WITSML 2.1 Log with a time-depth curve pair (no dedicated object)
differences: Depth type, time kind, units and the datum are the uploader's statements; unstated ones stay unknown, never defaulted.
The wellbore is an explicit of-entity association, not a WellboreID read from the file.
The velocity column is carried as stated; it is not recomputed from the pairs.

types.osdu: none: a text format; its normalized profile is ophiolite.time-depth/1

licences: The standards are referenced by name only; no schema text is copied.
